$comment: Gazetteer of mapped places. Every coordinate records how it was derived and its positional uncertainty (metres). Coordinates are WGS84 longitude/latitude. 'irish_grid' (EPSG:29903) and 'itm' (EPSG:2157) values are converted by scripts/build-data.ts and take precedence over 'lonlat'. Places without a substantiated location are deliberately absent: events then carry no coordinates.

places.name: Ford of the Farset and Lagan (approximate)
places.derivation: Placed near the Farset mouth and the Queen's Bridge site; Wikipedia 'Belfast' describes the crossing as under or near the current Queen's Bridge. Not an archaeological find spot.

places.name: Site of Belfast Castle (town castle)
places.derivation: Wikipedia 'Belfast Castle' places the medieval and early-1610s castle on or near the same site, in central Belfast near Castle Place. Footprint not surveyed.

places.name: St George's Church, 105 High Street
places.historical_name: Chapel of the Ford; Corporation Church
places.derivation: Irish Grid reference from the NI Buildings Database record HB26/50/045 (10 m square), converted with the EPSG:29903 transformation.

places.name: Corner of High Street and Cornmarket
places.derivation: Contemporary descriptions place the Market House at the corner of High Street next to Corn Market. Position taken as the north-west corner of the block bounded by High Street, Ann Street, Cornmarket and Crown Entry, whose centre is recorded by excavation 2003:0011 at ITM 733890 874304.

places.name: Former Woolworth's site excavation (2003)
places.derivation: ITM coordinates published in the excavations.ie report 2003:0011.

places.name: Crown Entry (High Street to Ann Street)
places.derivation: Crown Entry forms the eastern boundary of the High Street/Ann Street/Cornmarket block (excavation 2003:0011 site name) and adjoins 10 Ann Street (Plan Belfast). Placed on that edge; not surveyed.

places.name: Sugarhouse Entry (High Street to Waring Street)
places.historical_name: Sugar House Entry — Dr Franklin Tavern
places.derivation: Geograph photo 502170 is taken at the Waring Street end (54.60077, -5.92680); the point is moved half-way along the entry towards High Street.

places.name: Joy's Entry (Ann Street to High Street)
places.derivation: Geograph photo 432099 (54.59933, -5.92641), taken from the Ann Street end looking towards High Street; point moved into the entry.

places.name: Pottinger's Entry (Ann Street to High Street)
places.derivation: Geograph photo 432119 position (Morning Star visible on the left, looking to High Street).

places.name: Waring Street
places.derivation: Mid-point of Waring Street between the Four Corners and Victoria Street, bracketed by the Assembly Rooms, Sugarhouse Entry and Cotton Court (HB26/50/278). A specific premises cannot be placed, so the uncertainty covers the street.

places.name: Exchange and Assembly Rooms, Four Corners
places.derivation: Coordinates published on the Wikipedia article (54°36′03.2″N 5°55′41.1″W).

places.name: High Street at Joy's Entry
places.derivation: The Joy's Entry plaque states McCracken was born in a house near the site; the Ulster History Circle plaque gives 37 High Street, Wikipedia gives 39 High Street. Placed where Joy's Entry meets High Street.
